column1: # The default relay and target pairs, in order: the first is tried first, the second after a hedge delay.
# A pair is refused when relay and target share an operator, a person, a jurisdiction, or a hosting or CDN AS;
# both pairs pass that rule on the values of relays.tsv and targets.tsv.
# Columns: relay (an id of relays.tsv), target (an id of targets.tsv).
